title: introduce-escrow-sync-operator-and-staged-key-promotion-for-airgapped-installs
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds Escrow Sync Operator (CRD + controller) and Terraform/Helm integration to enable HSM-backed key escrow and staged key promotion for private (air-gapped) deployments. Provides safe rollback hooks and local HSM simulator tests. Backwards-compatible; requires optional operator install for customers who opt into escrow. See migration notes for upgrading from sealed-secrets-only setups.
body: Context: Private, air-gapped Redwood installations need a safe and auditable way to move customer-encrypted secrets (sealed-secrets/Vault-wrapped) into an HSM-backed escrow so that recovery and cross-cluster promotion are possible without exposing plaintext keys. This PR introduces the Escrow Sync Operator: a lightweight controller that coordinates encrypted bundle ingestion, key wrapping to an HSM via PKCS#11/CloudHSM, and a staged promotion workflow (shadow -> warm -> active) with declarative rollback hooks for Terraform-managed resources. Motivation: reduce manual steps during key handoff, provide auditable promotion windows, and enable safe rollbacks after upgrades.
commits: a1b2c3d add EscrowConfig CRD and controller scaffold
b2c3d4e implement pkcs11 adapter and softHSM test harness
c3d4e5f helm: add escrow-operator chart and values for airgap bundles
d4e5f6a terraform: expose iam bindings and kms-escrow module
e5f6a7b tests: integration test using softHSM, USB token CI job
f6a7b8c docs: migration guide and runbook for staged promotion

--- a/api/v1alpha1/escrowconfig_types.go
+++ b/api/v1alpha1/escrowconfig_types.go
@@ -1,6 +1,16 @@
+// EscrowConfig declares a desired escrow state for a cluster.
+// Promotion phases: Shadow, Warm, Active.
+type EscrowConfig struct {
+    metav1.TypeMeta   `json:""`
+    metav1.ObjectMeta `json:""`
+    Spec EscrowConfigSpec `json:""`

tests_and_ci: CI: initial unit tests failed due to SoftHSM path on macOS runner; fixed by adding a containerized SoftHSM step. New CI job added: escrow-e2e-usb (runs in separate pool with USB token emulator). All checks green on merge. Summaries: unit (pass), integration (pass), lint (pass), terraform-check (pass), helm-lint (pass), e2e-escrow (pass)
discussion: Lena Ortiz (reviewer): Please add more logging around the PKCS#11 calls; debugging HSM errors in customer environments has historically been painful.
Asha Patel (author): Added structured logs at debug level for pkcs11 calls and wrapped errors with actionable suggestions. See controller logging changes in escrow_controller.go commit.

Marcus Green (reviewer): The staged promotion API looks good, but we should add a configurable promotion window defaulting to 24h and a way to force immediate promotion in emergency. Also add audit annotations on the EscrowConfig status.
Asha Patel (author): Implemented promotionWindow field with default 24h and an emergencyForce boolean. Audit annotations are now recorded on each status transition. Tests updated.
Priya Desai (security): How does this interact with existing sealed-secrets workflows? We cannot break automated reconcilers that expect a specific secret name format.

Asha Patel (author): The operator does not alter existing sealed-secret resources; it ingests exported bundles (TUF signed when airgapped) and writes an HSM-wrapped key material to a new namespaced EscrowSecret resource. We documented the migration flow to map names and avoid collisions. Added compatibility tests covering sealed-secrets-only clusters.
Marcus Green (reviewer): approve after CI fixes and addition of migration doc.
Lena Ortiz (reviewer): approved (minor follow-ups logged as ENG-4420)
MergeBot: Merged by squash merge after approvals and passing CI.
upgrade_notes: Upgrade path: optional operator. For clusters that want HSM escrow, install charts/escrow-operator with values-airgap.yaml. For Terraform-managed infra, import new module terraform/modules/kms-escrow and run plan/apply to create IAM bindings and HSM access roles. Migration: export sealed-secrets bundle using installer/bin/export-sealed-bundle, then create EscrowConfig referencing the bundle. Operator will perform a shadow promotion and expose a dry-run report. To commit, set promotionPhase=Warm then Active. Rollback: set promotionPhase back to Shadow within retention window; operator will unwrap new keys and restore prior escrow state. See docs/private-installer/escrow-migration.md for commands and sample manifests.
notes_for_sre: SREs: the operator records metrics in the escrow namespace: escrow_promotions_total, escrow_promotion_latency_seconds, escrow_hsm_errors_total. We added alert recipes: High rate of hsm_errors or promotion latency > 5m triggers P1. The operator uses a leader-election lock with default ttl 1m; increase for slow environments.
local_tests: Local: run make test-integration-escrow (spawns dockerized SoftHSM and runs the promotion flow). USB token emulation: hack/ci/usb-token-e2e.yaml can run in a VM with libusb passthrough. CI reproduces main scenarios via containerized SoftHSM.
manual_steps_taken: Ran final staging rollout against aws-staging (airgapped env) with a physical Yubikey attached to test harness. Verified audit annotations in cluster and confirmed rollback restored previous HSM-wrapped material.
risks: Operator introduces new privileged connector to HSM endpoints; access is gated by terraform module and RBAC. Mitigations: operator runs with minimal privileges, HSM adapter performs request signing, and all key material is wrapped before persistence. We included an optional read-only mode for dry-run audits.
